scope: First actual-clock finite-density and marked-law boundary extracted from A1.E1/A1.E2 and the unnamed clock iteration at A1.E7, with exhaustive surrounding A1.SS1 topology
source_standing_hypotheses: Potential on Euclidean R^d; source global Hessian contract alpha I <= Hess V <= beta I (S1.E1); fixed positive eta in the proximal-scale setting eta <= 1/beta (Section 2.2).
Fixed arbitrary y, reference x_tilde, and initial phase state zeta=(x,p); reference need not be a random conditional draw for this fixed-reference first-event statement.
Independent Exp(1) clocks for recursive process. For the first deterministic state only one unit exponential law is needed.
Actual harmonic center c=y-eta grad V(x_tilde), residual h(x)=grad V(x)-grad V(x_tilde), and rate lambda=sqrt(eta)*max(<p,h(x)>,0).
Actual reflection R_h=I-2hh^T/||h||^2 when h!=0, R_0=I; position is unchanged by the bounce.
proof_ingredients_not_new_source_binders: Continuity, nonnegativity and local integrability of the actual arc rate q(t)=lambda(Phi_t zeta).
A(t)=integral_0^t q(s)ds is continuous, differentiable where needed, nondecreasing, and zero at zero.
Actual flow measurability/continuity, actual reflection Borel measurability, cumulative-hazard generalized-inverse measurability, and threshold crossing facts.
Derivative of exponential survival; finite-measure uniqueness or generalized-inverse pushforward substitution; mark-map pushforward.
Energy conservation and finite pathwise rate cap are derived facts, not assumptions to be promoted to public source binders.
Recursive conditional independence, terminal survival, nonexplosion and all-event-time density iteration are additional ingredients for A7, not conclusions of a first finite event theorem.

first_clock_reconstruction.definitions: q(t)=lambda(Phi_t zeta); A(t)=integral_0^t q(s) ds; S=inf{u>=0:A(u)>=E}, with S=infinity when the set is empty; E~Exp(1).
first_clock_reconstruction.survival: For finite t>=0, P(S>t)=exp(-A(t)). Equal-threshold issues at E=0 or limiting cumulative hazard are null events handled explicitly; deterministic e=0 may yield S=0.
first_clock_reconstruction.finite_density: The positive finite part has measure P(S in B, 0<S<infinity)=integral_(B intersect (0,infinity)) q(t)*exp(-A(t)) dt for Borel B. It is generally a subprobability measure.
first_clock_reconstruction.infinite_mass: P(S=infinity)=exp(-lim_(t->infinity) A(t)), with exp(-infinity)=0. Neither finite event nor strictly positive rate at every t is a source assumption.
first_clock_reconstruction.marks: On the positive finite branch the mark is (S, Phi_S zeta, actualBounce(Phi_S zeta)); its measure is the pushforward of q(t)exp(-A(t))dt by the deterministic actual mark map.
first_clock_reconstruction.default_zero: A total real-valued finite-clock representative may assign 0 to an infinite or nonpositive branch only as an implementation encoding whose theorems restrict to positive times/finite branch. It is not the source waiting-time semantics and never creates an actual t=0 event.
first_clock_reconstruction.zero_normal: The actual bounce is defined for zero normal by identity. Nonzero-normal assumptions cannot replace that global definition. Zero-rate times carry zero finite-event-density mass.
first_clock_reconstruction.source_status: These are source-faithful local consequences of A1.E1/A1.E2 and the implicit iteration invoked at A1.E7, not separately numbered claims explicitly printed by the authors.

alternative_density_routes.logic: OR between sufficient routes; common actual-clock definitions and measurability form shared parents. Do not require both derivations as a false AND.
alternative_density_routes.route_cdf: Threshold equivalence + exponential survival AND FTC/derivative of exp(-A) AND Borel finite-measure uniqueness imply finite density.
alternative_density_routes.route_pushforward: Exponential-clock density AND monotone cumulative-hazard generalized inverse with correct plateaus/finite branch AND pushforward/substitution identity imply finite density.
alternative_density_routes.source_provenance: Paper specifies integrated hazard construction and iterates it; it does not explicitly prescribe either expanded density proof. These routes are reviewer reconstructions of omitted bookkeeping.

A7_forward_OPEN: Conditional unused-tail law: after each consumed clock and reached state, remaining Exp(1) clocks retain their product law conditional on generated history; deterministic-state first-event law alone does not establish this.
Iterate conditional marked transition laws through arbitrary n, with measurable state-dependent kernels and strict ordered-time simplex bookkeeping.
Include final no-event survival through the horizon, including infinite next wait; boundary event times at 0 and t have zero mass but need proof/handling.
All finite-horizon paths are represented by a finite event count using source nonexplosion; sum of exact-count laws equals the entire path law.
Path-functional measurability, prescribed-time path construction and terminal survival factor; zero-event term uses empty product and deterministic path.

Absolute convergence pointwise in initial state from energy-local cap and simplex volume; do not silently infer integrability of exp(cap*t) under the phase law. Probability normalization and Tonelli supply the appropriate integrated control.

Complete path reversal still requires A4, A5, A6, full A7, Borel endpoint/time change, survival-density matching, and termwise integration; first marked law does not establish stationarity or operator results.
